title: Match Outcome Prediction Algorithm
description: This project builds a predictive algorithm to forecast the outcome of sporting matches (e.g., win/draw/lose) by leveraging historical match data, feature engineering and machine learning classification models. It covers data collection, preparation (cleaning, feature creation), model training and evaluation, implemented in Python notebooks and/or scripts. The workflow demonstrates end‑to‑end ability to handle raw match data through to probabilistic outcome predictions.
